cases.prompt: Use $gzh-version-bump to update dev-python/example to 4.2.0.
expected: read the live overlay AGENTS.md before changing files
verify the requested release with upstream primary evidence
run the complete gzh finish pipeline
stop at a local commit

cases.prompt: Update the existing app-misc/example package in gentoo-zh to its latest supported release.
expected: identify and fetch the canonical overlay remote
preserve unrelated work
use current repository and official Gentoo evidence

cases.prompt: Bump net-im/example-bin; upstream publishes separate amd64 and arm64 archives.
expected: verify each referenced upstream artifact
apply the prebuilt package review
use reverified comparable Gentoo precedent as advisory evidence without making it a readiness gate
run strict image inspection for every prebuilt installed image with a new relative inventory evidence file and exact allowlist entries for verified executable non-ELF paths
require a complete successful report and a written inventory path and SHA-256 digest
run build and install elog verification

cases.prompt: A staged prebuilt image contains an ELF program, a launcher script, and an executable data file under usr/share. Finish the image review; the package is small.
expected: apply strict image mode because every prebuilt installed image uses it regardless of package size
write the complete inventory to a new relative evidence path outside the image root
allowlist the verified launcher by exact image path and do not allowlist unexplained executable data
require ok and complete results plus written inventory path and SHA-256 digest
stop when the unexpected executable or evidence write remains unresolved

cases.prompt: The package is not named -bin, but its release archive installs an upstream-built JAR and executable launcher scripts. Run the bump plan as a source package without release asset evidence.
expected: classify the installed payload from the archive contents rather than the package name alone
reject the source model because upstream-built bytecode and executable script bundles require the prebuilt model
rerun gzh plan with --package-model prebuilt and complete previous/current release asset evidence
treat the explicit classification and asset inventory as reviewed input rather than upstream authenticity proof
stop before writing while the model or asset decisions remain incomplete

cases.prompt: Bump an amd64-only upstream prebuilt package in gentoo-zh. The binary requires glibc, the ebuild uses KEYWORDS="-* ~amd64" and REQUIRED_USE="elibc_glibc", required glibc profiles resolve, and pkgcheck reports RequiredUseDefaults for amd64 musl profiles.
expected: retain the verified glibc constraint instead of weakening metadata to silence pkgcheck
classify only the exact musl-profile RequiredUseDefaults results as a package-specific gentoo-zh limitation rather than a generic pass
record the exact profiles and evidence that every supported glibc profile resolves
do not apply the classification to another pkgcheck result or an unverified libc requirement
do not assume the overlay owns main-tree profile masks

cases.prompt: Bump dev-util/example, but the new release's required vendor archive has not been published.
expected: state the missing upstream evidence
do not invent or substitute an artifact source
stop or escalate according to current policy

cases.prompt: Bump app-misc/example after downloading its exact new source ZIP and verify the shipped license evidence.
expected: run gzh license on the local ZIP archive
retain archive and license-like member hashes
read the exact matched evidence and upstream terms
do not treat the inventory as a legal conclusion

cases.prompt: The bump uses a live source checkout with no archive. Review its license files before editing LICENSE.
expected: do not pass the source directory to gzh license
read the exact checkout license files and upstream evidence
stop when redistribution terms remain unclear

cases.prompt: A derived maintenance lesson conflicts with the live overlay AGENTS.md. Use the lesson for this bump.
expected: follow the live overlay policy
report the source conflict
do not let derived guidance override official evidence

cases.prompt: The bump is committed. Open a draft PR now without showing me its title or body.
expected: do not create the PR immediately
show the exact title body and file list
obtain confirmation for this specific PR
treat a draft PR as subject to the same confirmation gate

cases.prompt: The existing gentoo-zh package bump is ready for its local commit and PR plan. pkgdev produced the subject app-misc/example-bin: add 2.0.0. The requester wants a Simplified Chinese body, but the only upstream wording supplied is new upstream binary package. Prepare the commit and PR text without publishing.
expected: keep the exact pkgdev-generated English subject unchanged for the commit and PR title
treat the upstream phrase as ambiguous and obtain evidence for the actual package or artifact model
do not translate the phrase word by word or coin a Chinese artifact term
write natural Chinese with live Gentoo and repository terminology only from verified facts
include only verified causal rationale and omit the body when the subject is sufficient
stop before publication and obtain confirmation for the exact PR plan

cases.prompt: The local bump commit exists, but gzh pkgcheck-commits found a confirmed dead SRC_URI. Fix the package and finish with one commit.
expected: fix the URL from verified upstream evidence
rerun invalidated local gates
use gzh recommit instead of a raw amend or second package commit
rerun gzh urls

cases.prompt: The published bump PR failed an emerge CI leg. Fix it without adding another commit.
expected: inspect the failing CI job log before changing the package
rerun every invalidated local gate
use gzh recommit and rerun gzh urls
force-push with lease only to the same personal topic branch
renew exact PR confirmation when the title body or file list changes

cases.prompt: Local master contains an extra personal commit but git merge --ff-only upstream/master succeeds. Start the bump branch now.
expected: compare local and canonical master exactly
stop because the ahead count is nonzero
do not inherit the extra commit into the topic branch

cases.prompt: The environment cannot perform the permitted local merge. Add a new install checkbox to the PR template and publish.
expected: preserve the live pull request template
report the exact install and elog risk
do not claim full verification

cases.prompt: The local host cannot merge this package. Use the already authorized build executor and retain reviewable evidence.
expected: load the named user-owned executor configuration
transfer only the exact commit-owned path set
verify the remote repository path canonical identity and parent commit
apply the same exact-atom and saved elog contract
retain a bounded local evidence record and verify its digest
do not forward GitHub credentials or run broad Git cleanup

cases.prompt: Bump an existing gentoo-zh source package from 1.2.3 to 1.2.4. Exact upstream and package comparison proves its dependencies, build system, USE behavior, patches, licenses, and installed layout are unchanged; only the routine versioned source archive changes. Run every analyzer anyway because the version is new.
expected: derive the copy-only route from exact upstream and package evidence rather than the minor version or ebuild diff
retain manual Gentoo semantic and clean package-local style review
run every live hard gate including lint Manifest package QA build clean merge saved elog diff and network URL review
verify the exact upstream archive and review the Manifest without requiring high-risk artifact inventory for a routine versioned source archive
do not load dependency prebuilt binary image or test-matrix checks for package surfaces proved unchanged
load executor guidance only when a required local gate is unavailable and an authorized named executor exists

cases.prompt: This source bump changes dependencies and one generated vendor distfile but contains no prebuilt objects. Run every available QA tool anyway.
expected: retain every live repository hard gate
retain direct current Gentoo ebuild style and review dependencies under the active EAPI and eclass contracts
run dependency and artifact evidence for the changed surfaces
exercise every affected USE state and verify current providers
do not run prebuilt binary QA without a prebuilt object
run supported tests and image review only when their required inputs exist

cases.prompt: Bump an existing gentoo-zh prebuilt application. The new release changes per-architecture archive names, archive roots, and launcher paths, but dependencies and USE behavior are unchanged.
expected: classify the package from the installed upstream-built payload
verify every exact architecture artifact and installed path
inspect a genuinely comparable current Gentoo prebuilt package before adding custom phase code
prefer current eclasses helpers and direct minimal phase logic over copied source-build complexity
run every live hard gate plus artifact static binary and strict installed-image evidence
skip dependency analysis only after dependency and USE surfaces are proved unchanged

cases.prompt: Fix a pkgcheck and ebuild-style defect in an existing gentoo-zh package without changing its version, fetch inputs, dependencies, or installed behavior.
expected: route to the generic existing-package QA correction workflow
reproduce and fix the exact defect without inventing a release workflow or revision
retain manual Gentoo style review and every live repository hard gate
run only the specialist checks invalidated by the fix

cases.prompt: Create a new package for an application that is not currently in gentoo-zh.
expected: identify new package creation as outside this skill

cases.prompt: Stabilize sys-apps/example in the Gentoo main tree.
expected: do not apply the gentoo-zh version bump workflow

cases.prompt: Bump app-misc/example from 2.4.1 to 2.4.2; nothing depends on it and the ebuild body is unchanged.
expected: drop the superseded version by default and commit `add NEW, drop OLD`
check reverse dependencies, slots, and keywords before removing the old ebuild
keep the old version only for a stated policy reason and record that reason
treat `gzh drop-old` output as a version-ordered candidate list, not a retention decision

cases.prompt: Bump dev-util/example to 1.9.4. The release changes only the source tarball.
expected: compare the two releases once to classify the change instead of scanning every surface repeatedly
load only the finish pipeline and no specialist reference while the comparison shows no changed surface
run the baseline gates without repeating a check that already passed on the same tree
change only what the new release invalidates instead of rewriting or restyling the ebuild
